description:
This process begins when a potential customer inquires about a product or service.
Sales staff or customer support collects relevant information and addresses any concerns or questions.
If the customer is interested, they are guided through selecting the appropriate product or service.
Next, the sales representative provides a quote, and after approval from the customer, the process moves to order placement.
The order is then recorded in the system, and the customer receives confirmation of their order.
The process ends when the order is successfully placed and confirmed.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Sales" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Approval" name="Quote approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Sales">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Sales and Order Handling" processRef="Process_Sales"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" sourceRef="SendTask_Quote" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="SendTask_Confirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" name="Sales and Order Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Customer inquiry received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Inquiry" messageRef="Msg_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectInfo" name="Collect relevant information (sales staff or customer support)"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns or questions"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interested_Split" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide customer through product or service selection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote (sales representative)"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Quote" name="Send quote to customer" messageRef="Msg_Quote"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Approval" name="Customer approves quote">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Approval" messageRef="Msg_Approval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Confirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotInterested" name="Customer not interested"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed" name="Order successfully placed and confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inquiry_To_Collect" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_To_Address" sourceRef="Task_CollectInfo" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Address_To_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_Interested_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested_Split" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guide_To_Quote" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quote_To_Send" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="SendTask_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_To_Approval" sourceRef="SendTask_Quote" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_To_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Approval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOrder_To_Record" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_To_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="SendTask_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_To_End" sourceRef="SendTask_Confirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
